decisions.reason: A safety shoe line sits squarely in the firm's core business, and one year on the market is too short to judge it against aspiration, while ample slack lets the firm carry it.
The comfort insole is a low-cost complement to the core footwear, so a modest shortfall would not trigger problemistic search, though it faces some overlap with the other new insoles.
The supportive insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, but with three new insoles launched together it is a likely candidate if the range is pruned.
The ergonomic series has a page of its own, which signals strategic commitment and expected performance at or above aspiration, and it matches the firm's innovation goals.
Firefighter boots open a specialised segment that uses the firm's in-house manufacturing, and slack allows the uncertain early results to be tolerated.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page, which signals that management rates it highly, so dropping it soon is unlikely.
